example_sentences_in_bangla: তিনি সবসময় বসের জৌহুকুম করে থাকেন।
জৌহুকুম করে কাজ পাবেন ভেবো না।
example_sentences_in_english: He is always flattering the boss with 'jo hukum'.
Don't think you'll get the job by being a sycophant.
history: Derived from Persian 'jo hukum' meaning 'as per order', commonly used during Mughal influence in Bengal to denote subservience or flattery.
note: Often used sarcastically in modern Bengali speech.
